simple.meaning: תַּעַר (taʻar) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare , i.e. empty).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare , i.e. empty)
definitions.full: H8593. taar תַּ֫עַר noun masculine Psa 52:4 and ( Isa 7:20 ) feminine razor, sheath ; — 1. a. razor , absolute בְּת ׳יְגַלַּח Isa 7:20 (figurative); subject of עַלרֿאֹשׁ יַעֲבֹר לֹא Num 6:5 , object of עַלֿ הֶעֱבִיר 8:7 (P), compare construct ׳ת הַגַּלָּבִים Ezek 5:1 ; absolute ׳כְּת מְלֻטָּשׁ Psa 52:4 (simile of tongue). b. construct ׳ת הַסֹּפֵר Jer 36:23 = penknife . 2 sheath , always suffix of sword: בְּתַעְרָהּ 2Sam 20:8 ; of drawing sword, מִתּ ׳שָׁלַף 1Sam 17:51 , מִתּ ׳הוֺצִיא Ezek 21:8 ; 21:10 , מִתּ ׳תֵּצֵא 21:9 ; of sheathing, אֶלתַּֿרְעֵךְ הֵאָֽסְפִי Jer 47:6 ; אֶלתַּֿעְרָהּ הָשַׁב Ezekiel 21:35.

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
Then David ran, stood over the Philistine, took his sword, drew it out of its sheath, killed him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.
In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
When Jehudi had read three or four leaves, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.
“ ‘You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you are quiet?

“You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
“Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says:
It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter.
